title: End completed-work reports with explicit user action requirements
abstract: When reporting a completed work session or development deliverable, end the summary with a clearly separated user-action section. State each approval, decision, choice or input genuinely needed to proceed, identifying what it unblocks. If no user action is necessary, explicitly state that nothing is required. Keep optional follow-up suggestions distinct from mandatory action, and do not imply that automatic work authorization follows from reporting a possible next step.

source.reference: Generalized completed-work reporting format requirement; private source dialogue not retained

scope_hints.scope_boundary: Work completion or deliverable reports. Do not require the section in unrelated casual replies, and do not invent dependencies or falsely mark optional actions as mandatory.

unresolved: During later rule normalization, define a compact standardized footer label and distinguish required blockers from discretionary review opportunities without hiding real user decisions.
remarks: Queue-only, independent completion-reporting atom, generalized from a formatting requirement. This does not publish or apply a rule or modify any profiles.
